Free. Private. Peer-to-peer.

You're not alone in your IBD journey.

ENTYVIO® has partnered with PatientPartner so you can connect with a real patient who has been through vedolizumab treatment — someone who truly understands the highs, the hard days, and what to expect along the way.

How it Works

01

Tell Us About Yourself

Complete a short form sharing your experience with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis and where you are in your ENTYVIO® journey. Your answers help us find the most relevant mentor match for you.

02

Get Matched With a Mentor

We'll connect you with a volunteer PatientPartner mentor who has personal experience with ENTYVIO® and has managed IBD themselves — someone who truly gets it and wants to help.

03

Start the Conversation

Message your mentor directly. Ask questions, share concerns, and get real peer support on your schedule. All conversations are private, secure, and on your terms.

Real People, Real Support

Hear how mentors made an impact.

Sofia R. Denver, CO — Runner, living with Crohn's disease
"
"I was diagnosed at 28 and terrified I'd have to give up the active lifestyle I loved. My mentor — who's also in her 30s and runs marathons on ENTYVIO® — completely changed my perspective. She walked me through the infusion schedule, what to eat before runs, and how she got back to full activity. I needed to hear it from someone actually living it."
👨
Kevin L. Chicago, IL — Managing ulcerative colitis since age 31
"
"In my early 30s with a demanding job and a busy social life, I didn't know how to fit a biologic into my routine. My mentor had the same concerns — he explained how he manages infusion days around his schedule and what flares look like once ENTYVIO® kicks in. That honest, peer-level conversation gave me the confidence to commit to the treatment."

PatientPartner is not intended for use in medical emergencies. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 immediately or go to the nearest emergency department. Frequently Asked Questions

The ENTYVIO® mentorship program, powered by PatientPartner, connects patients and caregivers living with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis with trained volunteer mentors who have personal experience with vedolizumab. It's a free, private, peer-to-peer support program designed to help you feel informed and confident on your treatment journey.
Yes — completely free for patients and caregivers. There is no cost to sign up, connect with a mentor, or use the platform at any time.
Mentors are real patients (or caregivers) who have firsthand experience with ENTYVIO® and managing Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis. They've volunteered to support others going through a similar journey. They are not medical professionals and do not provide medical advice — they share personal experience only.
After you complete the short form above, our system matches you with a mentor based on your condition, your experience with ENTYVIO®, and your personal needs. You'll typically be connected within 24–48 hours.
All communication happens through PatientPartner's secure, HIPAA-compliant messaging platform. You can message your mentor at any time that works for you — there's no scheduled call or appointment required.
You can ask your mentor anything about their personal experience with ENTYVIO® — what starting infusions or the pen injection was like, side effects they experienced, how it fit into daily life while managing IBD, and what they wish they had known. Think of it as a trusted conversation with someone who truly understands.
No. Mentors share personal experience only — not medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment recommendations. For all medical questions about your Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or ENTYVIO® treatment, always consult your gastroenterologist or healthcare provider.
Most patients are matched within 24–48 hours of completing the signup form. Your mentor will reach out to introduce themselves through the PatientPartner platform. The industry average wait time is 6 weeks — we believe patients shouldn't have to wait that long for support.
Yes. All conversations are private and conducted through PatientPartner's HIPAA-compliant, secure messaging platform. Your personal health information is never shared without your explicit consent. You can feel safe being open about your experience with IBD.
